children: US early education provider's Q3 revenue rose 5% yr/yr, slightly missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 rose 15% and beat analyst expectations
Company posted net loss due to $294 mln impairment in international operations
Company sees 2026 revenue at about $3.07 bln
Bright Horizons expects 2026 diluted adj EPS between $4.98 and $5.03
BACK-UP CARE GROWTH - Co said Q3 revenue growth was primarily driven by 13% increase in back-up care services
INTERNATIONAL IMPAIRMENT - Co said $294 mln impairment in international operations drove operating loss
HIGHER INTEREST AND TAXES - Co said higher interest expense and effective tax rate reduced adjusted net income
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the personal services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Bright Horizons Family Solutions Inc. is $88.34, about 27.5% above its October 28 closing price of $69.29
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
